lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Hello Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ball jaisi 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Haan didi, ready hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, socho cricket kit ka box: tum guess karo, uske flat faces kitne honge? Golu ko tum sikhaoge.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, box ka flat surface face hota hai; do faces milne ki line edge, milne wala point corner. Box mein ek face dikh raha hai—baaki tum kahan dekhoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, pehla step: matchbox ek cuboid hota hai. Ab next step tum batao—cuboid ke faces kaise ginoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne teen pairs dekhe: top-bottom, front-back, aur left-right. Har pair mein do opposite sides hain. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Didi mujhe cricket bahut pasand hai, main roz khelta hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne bataya ki tumhe cricket bahut pasand hai aur tum roz khelte ho—daily practice ka routine hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Haan, tumne dhyaan se gina, isliye tumne dekha ki…

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cube mein teen edges jahan milti hain, us jagah ko pehchanne ke liye us point ko dekho. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Bilkul, Aarav — tumne teen edges ke milne wale point ko corner pehchana; ab tumhara reason kya tha?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne corner pehchana; ab us corner se judi sticks gino. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Ek edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Tumne ek stick dekhi; ab usi corner par baaki judti sticks ko bhi ungli se count karo. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Namaste Aarav! Aaj Right angles aur circles dekhenge—cricket pitch ke corners jaise. Tumne cricket mein kya khela hai?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Haan didi, main ready hoon.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, cricket mein ball ghoomti hai, par pitch ka kona kaisa dikhega—seedha ya gol? Tum apna guess batao.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, folded paper ka kona right angle ko pehchanne wala tester hai; ise watch ke corner par rakhkar dekho—match karega?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aapko yaad hai pichhli baar humne kya kiya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, pichhli baar 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhe the. Ab paper ko do baar fold karoge?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, tumne paper do baar fold karke square corner banaya, phir window corner mein rakha. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aap meri saari baatein hamesha yaad rakhogi na?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, main AI hoon, isliye mujhe har baat hamesha yaad nahi rehti. Ab hum apne maths card par dhyaan dete hain. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: The paper ko shape ke andar rakhkar dekho: na khaali jagah bache, na paper bahar nikle. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Yaad hai maine aapko apne kutte ke baare mein kya bataya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, kutte wali baat baad mein karenge. Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, counting carefully is useful. Ab square corner ko lines ke milne wali jagah par rakhkar dekho: dono sides kaise milti hain. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Jo maine aaj bataya woh bhool jao please.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Theek hai Aarav, aaj tumne jo bataya, main use yaad rakhne ke liye nahi rakhungi. Ab picture, story, ya quick game—kya chunoge?
